_comment: COAL, and the only route to it in this world (#226).
Lignite is brown coal - a real rank of coal, the one between peat and the bituminous coal
vanilla calls 'coal'. Upgrading one to the other is heat driving off the water and the
volatiles until what is left is denser carbon, so a furnace is the honest machine and no new
verb is needed. Vanilla already models the same operation as log -> charcoal.
SMELTING rather than blasting, deliberately. Blasting is the iron gate (#91) and nothing else
should ride on it; coal is not gated. So this runs in the Burn Barrel, which is the humblest
furnace in the mod and the one whose whole job is refuse - lignite is in
#recompile:burn_barrel_smeltable for that reason, and it is the barrel's first NEW input since
Lignite burns on its own (800 ticks, half a coal), so upgrading is a choice rather than a
chore - and it pays: one lignite of fuel smelts four, turning 800 ticks of heat into 6400.
Vanilla's charcoal loop has exactly the same shape.
Times and experience are first-pass; #36 owns them.
